snippet.title: Videonauts Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing our new horror adventure game, Videonauts, now available for Windows, Mac, & Linux!!! 

Get it today (and please leave us a review)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678420/Videonauts/
And join our discord!
https://discord.gg/SFmZNgduzP

Videonauts is a story-focused adventure puzzle game about escaping a spooky and dangerous mansion... and discovering the secret behind a bizarre video collection within. The game features multiple endings, mysterious puzzles where you search your environment, and hand-drawn limited-palette pixel art.

Choices you make matter... certain character traits will be remembered as you have conversations with others, which means even innocuous exchanges may change everyone's fate!
